# Mountain Electric Company — La Crescenta, California

Mountain Electric Company is an electrical and HVAC contractor in La Crescenta, California.
Owner Michael Olson has run the shop since November 1976.
We service, repair, and install electrical, air conditioning, and heating systems.
California license 326950, C-10 Electrical and C-20 Warm-Air Heating, Ventilating and Air-Conditioning.
We serve La Crescenta, La Canada, Glendale, Los Angeles, Burbank, Pasadena, South Pasadena, Altadena, Arcadia, Monrovia, Sunland, and Tujunga.
Service calls carry a $75 diagnostic fee, waived when you accept our estimate.
We give free second opinions on competitor estimates.
Phone (818) 248-2665. Mobile (818) 414-1725.
Email mtnelect@earthlink.net.
Shop address 2319 Henrietta Ave, La Crescenta, CA 91214.
Website https://mountainelectriccompany.com/
